# Capability Assessment Workshop

<!-- BREADRUMB PLACEHOLDER -->

---

> Systematic evaluation of organizational capabilities to identify strengths, gaps, and improvement priorities aligned with strategic objectives.

---
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#purpose]

### Purpose

Assess current organizational capabilities against strategic requirements, identify capability gaps, and prioritize capability development initiatives.
page_texts.4:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#objectives]

### Objectives

- Evaluate current capability maturity across key business and technology domains
- Identify capability gaps relative to strategic objectives and market requirements
- Prioritize capability development investments based on business impact
- Create capability improvement roadmap with clear milestones and success measures
- Align capability development with organizational strategy and resource constraints
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#success-criteria]

### Success Criteria

- **Comprehensive Assessment**: All critical capabilities evaluated against consistent criteria
- **Gap Identification**: Clear understanding of capability gaps and their business impact
- **Prioritized Roadmap**: Actionable capability development plan with resource allocation
- **Stakeholder Alignment**: Consensus on capability priorities and improvement approach

---

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#3-weeks-before-workshop]

### 3 Weeks Before Workshop

**Capability Framework Development:**

- [ ] Define capability domains and assessment dimensions
- [ ] Establish capability maturity model and scoring criteria
- [ ] Identify capability assessment stakeholders and subject matter experts
- [ ] Gather existing capability documentation and assessments

**Strategic Context Analysis:**

- [ ] Review organizational strategy and strategic objectives
- [ ] Analyze market requirements and competitive landscape
- [ ] Identify key business processes and value chains
- [ ] Understand resource constraints and investment priorities
page_texts.8:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#2-weeks-before-workshop]

### 2 Weeks Before Workshop

**Assessment Preparation:**

- [ ] Develop capability assessment questionnaires and tools
- [ ] Schedule stakeholder interviews and data gathering sessions
- [ ] Prepare capability mapping templates and visualization tools
- [ ] Coordinate with capability owners and process experts

**Data Collection:**

- [ ] Conduct preliminary capability assessments with key stakeholders
- [ ] Gather performance data and capability metrics
- [ ] Document current state processes and technology landscape
- [ ] Identify capability interdependencies and relationships
page_texts.9:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#1-week-before-workshop]

### 1 Week Before Workshop

**Workshop Preparation:**

- [ ] Complete pre-workshop capability scoring and analysis
- [ ] Prepare workshop materials and facilitation tools
- [ ] Brief facilitators and subject matter experts
- [ ] Confirm participant availability and roles

page_texts.23:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#capability-maturity-model]

### Capability Maturity Model

| Level                          | Description             | Characteristics                                                       |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **1 - Initial**                | Ad hoc, reactive        | Informal processes, inconsistent outcomes, high variability           |
| **2 - Managed**                | Some structure          | Basic processes defined, some consistency, limited metrics            |
| **3 - Defined**                | Standardized            | Well-defined processes, consistent execution, performance measurement |
| **4 - Quantitatively Managed** | Measured and controlled | Process performance quantitatively understood and controlled          |
| **5 - Optimizing**             | Continuous improvement  | Focus on continuous process improvement and innovation                |
page_texts.24:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#capability-assessment-template]

### Capability Assessment Template

```markdown
## Capability: [Capability Name]

### Current State Assessment

-   **Maturity Level**: [1-5 rating with justification]
-   **Key Strengths**: [What works well currently]
-   **Major Gaps**: [Critical weaknesses and missing elements]
-   **Performance Metrics**: [Current performance indicators and trends]

### Strategic Requirements

-   **Target Maturity**: [Desired future state level]
-   **Business Drivers**: [Why this capability matters strategically]
-   **Success Measures**: [How success will be measured]
-   **Timeline Expectations**: [When capability needs to be developed]

### Gap Analysis

-   **Maturity Gap**: [Current vs. target state difference]
-   **Business Impact**: [Effect of gap on business performance]
-   **Investment Required**: [Estimated resources needed for improvement]
-   **Risk Level**: [Risk of not addressing the gap]

### Improvement Recommendations

-   **Development Approach**: [Build, buy, partner strategy]
-   **Key Initiatives**: [Major improvement activities]
-   **Timeline**: [Implementation phases and milestones]
-   **Success Factors**: [Critical enablers for success]
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#assessment-facilitation-techniques]

### Assessment Facilitation Techniques

**Objective Evaluation**

- Use evidence-based assessment criteria and scoring rubrics
- Encourage honest self-assessment while validating with data
- Balance optimism with realistic assessment of current state
- Focus on improvement opportunities rather than blame

**Stakeholder Engagement**

- Include diverse perspectives from across the organization
- Manage different viewpoints on capability maturity levels
- Build consensus through structured discussion and validation
- Ensure business and technical perspectives are balanced

**Strategic Alignment Maintenance**

- Keep assessment focused on strategic relevance and business impact
- Connect capability gaps to business outcomes and performance
- Prioritize based on strategic objectives and resource constraints
- Balance short-term needs with long-term capability building
page_texts.28:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#common-assessment-challenges]

### Common Assessment Challenges

**Capability Definition Ambiguity**

- **Challenge**: Unclear or overlapping capability definitions
- **Solution**: Clear capability framework with defined boundaries

**Assessment Subjectivity**

- **Challenge**: Inconsistent scoring across assessors
- **Solution**: Detailed scoring criteria and evidence requirements

**Strategic Misalignment**

- **Challenge**: Capability priorities not aligned with strategy
- **Solution**: Clear strategic context and business impact weighting

**Resource Reality Gap**

- **Challenge**: Improvement ambitions exceeding available resources
- **Solution**: Realistic resource assessment and phased approach

### Immediate Deliverables (Within 48 Hours)

- **Capability Assessment Summary**: Executive overview of current state and key findings
- **Priority Gap Analysis**: High-impact capability gaps requiring immediate attention
- **Quick Win Opportunities**: Near-term improvement initiatives with high ROI
- **Resource Requirement Estimate**: Initial investment requirements for priority capabilities
page_texts.31:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#follow-up-deliverables-within-2-weeks]

### Follow-up Deliverables (Within 2 Weeks)

- **Comprehensive Capability Report**: Detailed assessment results and analysis
- **Capability Development Roadmap**: Multi-year improvement plan with milestones
- **Investment Business Case**: Business justification for capability development investments
- **Implementation Governance Plan**: Organizational structure and processes for execution
page_texts.32:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#long-term-tracking-ongoing]

### Long-term Tracking (Ongoing)

- **Capability Maturity Dashboard**: Regular monitoring of capability development progress
- **Performance Impact Analysis**: Business outcome correlation with capability improvements
- **Investment ROI Tracking**: Return on investment measurement for capability initiatives
- **Continuous Assessment Updates**: Regular capability reassessment and adjustment

page_texts.34:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#assessment-quality-metrics]

### Assessment Quality Metrics

- **Assessment Completeness**: All critical capabilities evaluated with sufficient detail
- **Stakeholder Participation**: Broad representation from relevant organizational areas
- **Evidence-Based Scoring**: Assessment ratings supported by objective evidence
- **Strategic Alignment**: Capability priorities clearly linked to business objectives
page_texts.35:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#improvement-planning-effectiveness]

### Improvement Planning Effectiveness

- **Actionable Roadmap**: Clear, implementable capability development plan
- **Resource Realism**: Investment requirements aligned with organizational capacity
- **Stakeholder Buy-in**: Leadership commitment to capability development priorities
- **Success Measurement**: Clear metrics and monitoring approach defined
page_texts.36:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#long-term-capability-impact]

### Long-term Capability Impact

- **Maturity Improvement**: Measurable advancement in capability maturity levels
- **Business Performance**: Improved business outcomes correlated with capability development
- **Strategic Enablement**: Enhanced organizational ability to execute strategic initiatives
- **Competitive Advantage**: Capability improvements providing market differentiation

page_texts.38:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#rapid-capability-assessment-half-day]

### Rapid Capability Assessment (Half Day)

- Focus on high-level capability gaps only
- Limited to critical business capabilities
- Executive stakeholder participation
- Suitable for annual capability reviews
page_texts.39:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#comprehensive-capability-assessment-3-days]

### Comprehensive Capability Assessment (3 Days)

- Detailed assessment across all capability domains
- Extensive stakeholder engagement and validation
- Comprehensive improvement planning and roadmapping
- Suitable for major organizational transformation
page_texts.40:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#domain-specific-assessment-1-day]

### Domain-Specific Assessment (1 Day)

- Focus on specific capability domain (e.g., technology, digital)
- Deep dive assessment with domain experts
- Targeted improvement planning for specific area
- Suitable for functional area improvement initiatives
page_texts.41:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/capability-assessment.md#competitive-capability-assessment-2-days]

### Competitive Capability Assessment (2 Days)

- Benchmark assessment against industry leaders
- Market requirement analysis and gap assessment
- Competitive positioning and differentiation strategy
- Suitable for market positioning and competitive strategy
